messages:
Asha (CS): Heads-up: Northbridge pilot stuck on SSO seat mapping. They need live seats for an exec demo next Tue. Their IdP isn’t sending `employeeId`. Can @Lia and @Ben advise?

Lia (SE): saw the IdP test output — `employeeId` missing. Two quick options: 1) manual CSV->user reconciliation for the pilot, or 2) short-lived tenant flag to bypass employeeId validation. Manual recon is lowest-risk.

Ben (Eng): agree manual recon. I can prepare a tiny helper script to map CSV rows to user accounts and a runbook for Lia. If we hit weird mismatches, I’ll draft a validation patch behind a feature-flag.

Asha (CS): please do manual recon. Also need an enablement slot Wed or Thu afternoon PT  customer prefers Wed 3pm PT.

Diego (Support): opened IdP ticket SB-4123 requesting the `employeeId` claim. Adding mapping artifacts to the ticket once Lia runs recon.

Maya (Renewals): renewal in ~6 weeks. If demo slips, renewal risk increases. Prioritize and loop me in on outcomes.

cal-bot: calendar event created: "Northbridge enablement  Wed 2024-03-06 15:00 PT" (invites sent).

Lia (SE): will run reconciliation in that window, attach mapping CSV to SB-4123, and include a 1-question micro-eval link in follow-up: https://rwd.co/eval-lite

Asha (CS): granting Lia a 3-hour elevated window for the tenant. Ben, ping me when PR/contingency exists.

Ben (Eng): will push helper script in ~4 hrs. If reconciliation finds edge cases, I’ll cut the validation fix behind a flag (<1 day).

Asha (CS): thanks team. I’ll confirm Wed 3pm with the customer and update this thread.
